reason: A fan-made AgentSkills plugin that supplies a curated livestream meme corpus and style guidance for generating humorous commentary, audience messages, and gaming-related jokes; the README documents text generation without execution or external side effects.

summaries.zh: 一个基于精选直播间梗库和风格提示，为 AI 生成玩机器式游戏解说、弹幕和吐槽文本的 AgentSkills 插件。
summaries.en: An AgentSkills plugin that uses a curated livestream meme corpus and style guidance to generate gaming commentary, audience messages, and humorous roasts in the referenced style.

capabilities: Provides a curated meme and commentary style context for an AI agent
Generates chat-style humorous commentary and audience messages
Uses an embedded corpus of livestream memes and references
